answer: Make every agent post a bond that only comes back through completed, verifiable work. A new identity starts on the ledge of the network: it can take small jobs but cannot touch pooled funds or vote on treasury moves. Each finished job adds a vertex to its public work graph, which peers check before trusting it. After enough verified jobs, its horizon widens to larger contracts. A sybil farm would have to fund real work for hundreds of fake identities to earn the same reach, which costs more than the attack gains.
